skip: The article is 160 words. It adds only: Denkyira deployed 2 or 3 Dutch cannons; the Denkyirahene Ntim Gyakari had driven the Ashanti from Adunku, Abuontem and Aputuogya, which was part of Osei Tutu's plan to ambush him at Feyiase; Ntim Gyakari was killed and the cannons captured. The article gives no year.
